logline: An overachieving country girl arrives in Tokyo for high school with grand ambitions and zero friends, and finds both in ways she did not plan for.

renewal.note: Season 2 confirmed in December 2024. Season 1 aired April to June 2023 on Crunchyroll.

bollymeter.basis: Nominated for Best Romance and Best Slice of Life at the 8th Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2024; won Best Animation Screenplay at the 29th Shanghai TV Festival Magnolia Awards; MyAnimeList ranked it 7th in Spring 2023 with a score of 8.16.

pull_quotes.text: The story is intelligent in how it honors discussions of hard topics without letting go of its heartwarming atmosphere.

seasons.review_body: P.A. Works' adaptation of Misaki Takamatsu's manga landed in Spring 2023 and quickly became one of the season's most discussed slice-of-life entries. Critics and audience consensus aligned around the show's distinctive emotional intelligence - it handles class anxiety, family pressure, and adolescent identity with specificity rather than trope shorthand. Mitsumi's optimism is written as a character trait with roots and limits, not a magical reset button. Reviewers at AniTrendz and Lost in Anime praised the synergy between character writing, voice performances, and P.A. Works' characteristically warm visual direction. The series won Best Animation Screenplay at the 29th Shanghai TV Festival and was nominated at the Crunchyroll Anime Awards. MyAnimeList community ranked it 7th across all Spring 2023 anime with an 8.16 score. Season 2 was confirmed in December 2024.
